{{Quote|I take it you're the valet.''"<br />"''The Witches respect shows of strength. Mostly, I blow stuff up.|Han Solo and Carrack|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
'''Carrack''' was a large [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in the aftermath of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] traveled into Dathomir's wilderness to find [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]], Carrack was hired as one of their guides. They found the Skywalkers and joined them in attending the [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] of the [[Raining Leaves Clan|Raining Leaves]] and [[Broken Columns Clan]]s. However, the conclave was sabotaged by multiple [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] attacks, and Carrack was severely injured during one such attack. He was forced to return to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] for medical treatment.
